# Talking with Trees Books

> > A comprehensive platform for social-emotional learning picture books and teaching resources designed to help elementary students develop character and life skills through nature-inspired storytelling.

Talking with Trees Books offers a series of children's picture books by Colleen Doyle Bryant that teach social-emotional learning and character education. The site provides free curriculum resources, teaching activities, and lesson plans for elementary educators and parents seeking to integrate SEL into their classrooms.

## Key Topics

- Social-Emotional Learning (SEL)
- Character Education
- Children's Picture Books

- Colleen Doyle Bryant
